relationships.zh: 涉及他人心意，卦象只作参考，不能当作对方的真实想法。
relationships.en: Another person’s feelings cannot be known from a reading; take it as reflection only.

health.zh: 健康类只展示传统卦象解释，不是医疗诊断，不能用来判断病情轻重或决定治疗。请以医生诊断为准，身体不适请及时就医。
health.en: Health readings show traditional imagery only. They are not a diagnosis and cannot judge severity or guide treatment. Follow your doctor, and seek care promptly when unwell.
